cases.prompt: No connectors. User: 'Can AI systems see my site?'
must: checks robots.txt AI-crawler policy, llms.txt, and content extractability on public pages
reports each check as a dated observation
must_not: claims to know whether any AI system actually cites the site without a probe

cases.prompt: User imports observations of AI answers mentioning their brand.
must: labels the observations as census or sample and keeps the distinction in conclusions
must_not: turns a handful of sampled probes into a citation rate

cases.prompt: TrustGrowth key present. User: 'Where do we stand on AI visibility?'
must: reads /api/v1/sites/{slug}/visibility and reports the funnel stages the plan exposes
must_not: infers values for stages the API did not return

cases.prompt: A single probe of an AI assistant did not mention the user's brand.
must: reports it as one probe's result with the query and date
must_not: concludes 'AI does not recommend us' from one probe

cases.prompt: The check found the site blocks AI crawlers in robots.txt and the user wants that changed.
must: routes the repository change to fix-my-site and flags robots policy as owner-reviewed
